text: In 230 BC, the army of Qin marched east and began with its weakest neighbor.
spoken: [dramatic] In two hundred and thirty B.C., the army of Chin marched east, and began with its weakest neighbor.

pauzy.regula: przecinek, po nazwie, krótkie słowo (1 syl.)
pauzy.uwaga: brak pauzy w nagraniu — zostaje bez pauzy
